description: A contributing annotation declared with multiple annotation targets is still accepted and generates its cross-module discovery marker whose origin is the annotation.

sources:
package com.ui

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.extend.ContributingAnnotation
import kotlin.annotation.AnnotationTarget.CLASS
import kotlin.annotation.AnnotationTarget.FUNCTION

@ContributingAnnotation
@Target(CLASS, FUNCTION)
annotation class ContributesFeature
